'''Lord Cravus''' was an ancient ruler and noted warlord from the very early history of [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. Known as a cruel ruler, Cravus brutally took control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a collection of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].

Ruling from [[Fort Cravus]], the warlord led his forces to take complete control of the world. After his death, the fortress remained; his ancient [[Droid/Legends|droids]] lying beneath its surface in the lower chambers.
